metadata.question: Was the soil in Washington more moist on November 22, 2021 than November 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use ERA5-Land daily aggregated soil moisture (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR), band volumetric_soil_water_layer_1, for Washington state on 2021-11-15 and 2021-11-22. If a date has no image, fall back to NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture (band ssm). 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed; these are model/microwave products. Ensure valid pixel count via reduceRegion count. 3. Logic: If collections empty -> C1. If valid pixel count 0 -> C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside [0, 1.2] m3/m3 -> C3. Otherwise compare means: 22 > 15 => A, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const states = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States'); const wa = states.filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Washington')).geometry(); const date1Str = '2021-11-15'; const date2Str = '2021-11-22'; // Helper to await getInfo function getInfoAsync(obj) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.getInfo(resolve, reject); }); } // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback async function fetchDailyImage(dateStr) { const date = ee.Date(dateStr); // Try ERA5-Land let col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') .filterDate(date, date.advance(1, 'day')) .select(['volumetric_soil_water_layer_1'], ['sm']) .filterBounds(wa); let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); if (size > 0) { return { img: ee.Image(col.first()), source: 'ERA5-Land', imgCount: size }; } // Fallback: SMAP HSL (gap-filled) col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture') .filterDate(date, date.advance(1, 'day')) .select(['ssm'], ['sm']) .filterBounds(wa); size = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); if (size > 0) { return { img: ee.Image(col.first()), source: 'SMAP-HSL', imgCount: size }; } return null; } async function computeStats(img, label) { const mean = ee.Number(img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wa, scale: 9000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sm')); const count = ee.Number(img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wa, scale: 9000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sm')); const meanVal = await getInfoAsync(mean); const countVal = await getInfoAsync(count); return { mean: meanVal, count: countVal }; } console.log('Region: Washington, USA'); console.log(`Dates: ${date1Str} vs ${date2Str}`); const rec1 = await fetchDailyImage(date1Str); const rec2 = await fetchDailyImage(date2Str); if (!rec1 || !rec2) { if (!rec1) console.log(`${date1Str} Images: 0`); if (!rec2) console.log(`${date2Str} Images: 0`); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`${date1Str} Source: ${rec1.source}, Images: ${rec1.imgCount}`); console.log(`${date2Str} Source: ${rec2.source}, Images: ${rec2.imgCount}`); // 3. Processing & pixel validation const stats1 = await computeStats(rec1.img, date1Str); const stats2 = await computeStats(rec2.img, date2Str); if (!stats1.count || !stats2.count || stats1.count === 0 || stats2.count === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation & validation const v1 = stats1.mean; const v2 = stats2.mean; console.log(`${date1Str} Pixels: ${stats1.count}, Mean SM: ${v1 !== null ? v1.toFixed(4) : 'null'} m3/m3`); console.log(`${date2Str} Pixels: ${stats2.count}, Mean SM: ${v2 !== null ? v2.toFixed(4) : 'null'} m3/m3`); if (v1 === null || v2 === null || isNaN(v1) || isNaN(v2) || v1 < 0 || v2 < 0 || v1 > 1.2 || v2 > 1.2) { console.log('C3'); return; } const diff = v2 - v1; console.log(`Difference (22-15): ${diff.toFixed(4)} m3/m3`); // 5. Final Answer if (diff > 0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.error('Error:', err.toString().slice(0, 200)); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
